name: cairo
title: Cairo · a ZK contract workbench
description: A Cairo/Starknet zero-knowledge contract workbench. Scaffold a Cairo 2 contract, vibecode it with an agent, build it and run its snforge tests — each contract is a self-contained Scarb project mounted as its own mod under orbit/cairo/src/mods/<name> (addressed cairo.<name>). Thin orchestration (Python stdlib) over the real toolchain already on this box: scarb 2.8.4, starknet-foundry (snforge/sncast) 0.31, universal-sierra-compiler. The 'vibecode' loop drives the headless Claude CLI, scoped to one submod, to write or edit Cairo and then verifies with build + test.
state: Contracts live in-tree as mods at orbit/cairo/src/mods/<name>/ (one Scarb project + mod.py anchor each, addressed cairo.<name>). No external state dir; scarb target/ and .snfoundry_cache/ are gitignored.

endpoints.GET /cairo/api/toolchain: scarb / snforge / sncast / claude presence + versions
endpoints.GET /cairo/api/get?name=: One submod: Scarb.toml, files, build state
endpoints.GET /cairo/api/read?name=&path=: Read a file inside a submod
endpoints.POST /cairo/api/new: Scaffold a contract submod (name, desc?, template?=counter)
endpoints.POST /cairo/api/write: Write a file inside a submod (name, path, content)
endpoints.POST /cairo/api/test: snforge test (name); no name = module self-test; async=true -> job
endpoints.POST /cairo/api/vibe: Agent-edit then build + test (name, prompt, model?); async=true -> job
endpoints.note: The app self-calls the same handlers under /cairo/_api/*; /api/cairo/* is the permanent legacy alias.
endpoints.POST /cairo/api/adopt: Pull legacy root-level contracts into src/mods/ and (re)write each one's mod.py/README/config anchor
endpoints.GET /cairo/api/templates: Starter contracts new() can scaffold (counter, token, commit_reveal, merkle_allowlist)
endpoints.GET /cairo/api/abi?name=: Built contract classes: entrypoints, constructor, events, Sierra/CASM size
endpoints.GET /cairo/api/whoami: Can this caller write? {writable, via, address, owners}

safety: vibe() runs the Claude CLI with --permission-mode acceptEdits scoped to a single submod directory (--add-dir), so edits and scarb/snforge runs stay inside that contract's project. It uses the host Claude OAuth credentials and spends against them. No keys are deployed and nothing is sent to a live chain; sncast is present for the user to deploy by hand. Publicly routed: reads are open, but every write (write/new/vibe/build/test/clean/remove/adopt) needs a loopback request or a mod-protocol token signed by the owner (config owner, build-console private-flag owner, or CAIRO_OWNERS).

layout.src/mod.py: anchor: new / vibe / build / test / ... (Python stdlib)
layout.src/api/server.py: stdlib HTTP server: protocol API + job table + serves the console
layout.src/build.sh: build the console -> src/releases/<ts>, flip src/dist atomically
layout.src/templates: contract scaffold: <template>/{lib,test}.cairo.tmpl, shared Scarb.toml.tmpl, mod.py.tmpl (per-contract anchor)
layout.src/mods/<name>/: one contract MOD per dir, addressed cairo.<name>: Scarb project + mod.py (parent fns bound to this contract) + config.json + README.md
